SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PLANT, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION_NO FROM TBL_KEP_RE WHERE 1 = 1 AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KA' AS SITE, 'HWAC' AS BUYER, PLANT, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION_NO, STATUS, ADD_DATE, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, UNIT_PRICE, REQ_USER_ID, REQ_USER_NAME, REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, REQ_USER_TELNO, REQ_USER_MAIL, CLOSE_DATE, CLOSE_TIME, ITEM_QTY, REMARK FROM TBL_KEP_RE WHERE 1 = 1 AND PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION_NO = '$G_RS.REVISION_NO$'
UDPATE TBL_KEP_RE SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = GETDATE() WHERE 1 = 1 AND PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION_NO = '$G_RS.REVISION_NO$'
